description: F4¾ transport arm: the `agentic` room exactly (tools-full bench, 4 actions per turn, speaking ends the turn) with the bench also declared as native tool definitions — the seat returns structured tool calls instead of writing [RUN]…[/RUN] in its prose, so a miswritten call can't be spoken to the room and bad arguments come back as a readable refusal. The room still describes its own furniture in its own voice; the schemas carry mechanics only. Pairs with `agentic` as a one-knob contrast (transport), as `agentic` pairs with `tools-full` (the loop). Exploratory, out of registered stats.
